end.summary:
Practised physical and chemical changes through melting ghee, burning biscuit, dissolving sugar, and roasting chapati.
Ananya explained that melting ghee is physical because the substance and properties remain the same and it can solidify again.
They identified gas, smoke, colour change, smell, and a new solid as signs of chemical change.
Chemical-change recognition was correct in both unaided attempts; the physical-change definition needed further practice.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying whether a change makes a new substance, using everyday examples. Ananya clearly explained the method for melting ghee: the substance stays the same, only its state changes, and it can solidify again. They mixed up some examples, especially dissolving sugar and the meaning of a new solid; this was not clearly corrected before the lesson ended. At home, ask them to sort a few examples into “new substance” and “same substance, different form,” giving one reason for each.
